preview.text: Bangladesh Champions play England Champions in a T20 match at Sharjah Cricket Stadium, where the usual first-innings score in the 82 recorded T20 matches is 153. England Champions won the toss and chose to bowl first.

summary.text: England Champions won by 7 wkts. BANCH made 164-9, Rony Talukdar top-scoring with 44 off 37 balls; Samit Patel took 4 for 17. ENGCH made 166-3, Ravi Bopara (c) top-scoring with 77 off 45 balls; Abu Jayed took 1 for 28. Sides batting first at Sharjah Cricket Stadium usually make about 153.
